e2e.name: GET /config: Core = Core Production origin, Torneos = the gateway, publishable key
GET jwks: exactly k1 + k2 public halves
POST /exchange (Core Production session) → RS256 k1, TTL 120, certified iss/aud, core_user_id bound
bridge bearer → Torneos REST through the gateway: own identity row (pre_request + custom_jwks + RLS)
re-exchange (the one allowed after a 401) → same Torneos identity
standby k2-signed bridge token → accepted by the gateway AND PostgREST (rotation needs no B03 write)
expired bridge token (> TTL + 5 s) → 401 (client: one re-exchange)
RPC outside the allowlist (commerce) → 403 rpc not enabled (never retried)
other origins (capacitor://localhost, https://localhost) → 403, no CORS (single certified origin kept)
Core contract unavailable → 503 CORE_UNAVAILABLE (REST and exchange), fail closed
Core Auth unreachable → 503 (fail closed, certified code)
Core session revoked → 401 on REST and on exchange
recorded: the bridge bearer is also valid directly on PostgREST until exp (≤ 125 s window, by design)
